verdict.rationale: Formant documents automations: events can trigger commands and webhooks, and it offers incident-response workflows. However, nothing in the pack shows versioning, change review, or rollback for those automations. The closest item, exporting device configuration to YAML or saving it as a template, covers device configuration rather than automations, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
